review: 702.171a-2: B controlled no land, so the spell_on_stack variant's Shock was unreachable; gave B an untapped Mountain in the setup and had the delta tap it for Shock.

702.171b-1: saddled_last_turn kept Grizzly Bears tapped from a saddle activated last turn, which A's untap step would have undone; the delta now states Grizzly Bears is untapped as part of that one fact.

scenarios.title: Saddle taps other creatures with enough total power and makes the permanent saddled until end of turn

setup.notes: Quilled Charger is a 4/3 Mount with saddle 2: 'Whenever Quilled Charger attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 and gains menace until end of turn.' B controls no creatures.

decisions: A activates the saddle ability of Quilled Charger, tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2).
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
A moves to combat and attacks B with Quilled Charger. Its attack trigger resolves. No blockers can be declared.

variants.label: enough_power
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is tapped as the cost. Quilled Charger becomes saddled, its attack trigger fires and it becomes a 5/5 with menace. B takes 5 damage and is at 15.

variants.label: not_enough_power
variants.delta: Fugitive Wizard (1/1) is on A's battlefield instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Saddling is not legal: the total power of the other untapped creatures is 1, less than 2. Quilled Charger is not saddled, its attack trigger does not fire, and it deals 4 damage. B is at 16.

variants.label: two_small_creatures
variants.delta: Two Fugitive Wizards (1/1 each) are on A's battlefield instead of Grizzly Bears; both are tapped to saddle.
variants.expected: Both Fugitive Wizards are tapped, their total power 2 meeting the cost. Quilled Charger becomes saddled, its attack trigger fires and it deals 5 damage. B is at 15.

scenarios.title: Saddle can be activated only as a sorcery

setup.notes: Quilled Charger has saddle 2. In the base the stack is empty and A has priority.

decisions: A considers activating the saddle ability of Quilled Charger, tapping Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: beginning_of_combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Activating saddle is not legal: it is not a main phase.

variants.label: spell_on_stack
variants.delta: B has cast Shock targeting A, tapping B's Mountain; Shock is on the stack and A has priority.
variants.expected: Activating saddle is not legal: the stack is not empty.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player instead of A.
variants.expected: Activating saddle is not legal: it is not A's turn.

scenarios.title: A permanent stays saddled until end of turn and not beyond

setup.notes: Quilled Charger has saddle 2 and 'Whenever it attacks while saddled, it gets +1/+2 and gains menace until end of turn.' In the base, earlier this turn A activated saddle in main1 tapping Grizzly Bears, and Quilled Charger became saddled. B controls no creatures.

decisions: A attacks B with Quilled Charger. Its attack trigger, if any, resolves. No blockers can be declared.

variants.label: saddled_this_turn
variants.expected: Quilled Charger is still saddled, its attack trigger fires and it becomes a 5/5 with menace. B takes 5 damage and is at 15.

variants.label: saddled_last_turn
variants.delta: Quilled Charger became saddled during A's previous turn, not this turn (so Grizzly Bears, tapped for that saddle, untapped in this turn's untap step).
variants.expected: Quilled Charger is no longer saddled, its attack trigger does not fire and it deals 4 damage. B is at 16. Grizzly Bears is untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: The leave-the-battlefield and not-copiable parts of the rule are not exercised here; a copy of a saddled Mount is summoning sick and cannot attack to show the designation.
